name: A Train Mystery
source:
In the game, you play a detective tasked with solving the murder of a famous film critic. There are three suspects: the Actress, the Banker, and the Understudy. You must interrogate each of them, choosing your questions carefully, and at the end make your accusation.

[From [url=https://adrian-clayton.itch.io/a-train-mystery]Itch.io[/url]]
